description: English-only fidelity pilot for amendment A1 with the plain English control (PREREGISTRATION section 13). NOT confirmatory and never pooled with rq2a: six judge-free retail test tasks outside RQ2's first 12 (53, 55, 56, 61, 64, 65) x 1 trial x en_plain only, with exactly the RQ2 settings. The Hindi arms were piloted with identical settings in rq2pilot2. Pass criteria fixed before the run (section 13); rewards are not used for the decision.
tau2_env_notes: Language-only personas for the Hindi arms (PREREGISTRATION section 13, amendment A1): with patches/tau2-multilingual-8ff48b8-language-only-personas.patch applied, the persona block keeps the gender line and pragmatics clause 0 (the language profile) and drops the conditional attitude clauses, which made gpt-oss-120b merge turns (docs/RESULTS_LOG.md, 2026-10-26 and 2026-10-29). No effect on en_plain, which has no persona.

simulators.name: gptoss120b
simulators.notes: Groq free plan: 200K tokens/day for this model, shared with the RQ1 gptoss120b runs on the same day. The per-condition estimates below replace tokens_per_task_estimate.

conditions.name: en_plain
conditions.notes: English control: the domain's base retail task set (ids without suffix; run_grid checks they match retail_en/retail_hi in evaluation_criteria, user_scenario and initial_state) with tau2's standard English user prompt and no persona (amendment A1, PREREGISTRATION section 13). The branch refuses retail_en without a persona. The English pack personas made gpt-oss-120b merge turns, also in their language-only form (pilot rq2pilot2). Same branch commit as the Hindi arms. Estimate = RQ1 gpt-oss-120b English cost (11,812 measured) padded ~10%.

conditions.name: hi_native
conditions.notes: Hindi in Devanagari (the branch default style). Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.

conditions.name: hi_romanized
conditions.notes: Estimate: 31,458 user tokens measured in ONE smoke simulation (task 0_hi, qwen3.8-27b simulator), padded ~10%. gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8's tokens in English, so ~42K is possible: re-measure after chunk 1. Smoke: 7 of 8 customer turns had Devanagari although style=romanized; check style compliance before reading this arm as romanized. Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.

conditions.name: hi_code_mixed
conditions.notes: Hinglish code-mixed. Same unmeasured-for-gpt-oss caveat as hi_romanized. Estimate raised 35K -> 42K on 2026-10-20 (gpt-oss-120b used ~1.3x qwen3.8-27b's tokens in English); re-measure after the first chunk.
